756520201.text: #Hey, it's you, {NICKNAME}! Fancy meeting you in the Whispering Woods again. What are the odds?

756520202.text: It's been a while, hasn't it? What've you been busy with lately?

756520205.text: Haha, that makes sense! This place is so beautiful and serene, it really does make for good photos.

756520206.text: This is my favorite patrol segment when I'm out on scouting missions.

756520207.text: This was where we met for the first time, too. I even mistook you for some kind of suspicious character back then, too! Ah, I'm getting embarrassed just thinking about it...

756520208.text: After all, it was thanks to your help that we averted the crisis with Dvalin, and restored peace to Mondstadt.

756520209.text: #But your {M#sister}{F#brother}... I put up so many missing posters, but it seems like it wasn't of any help...
